label: GO step, choosing a2 strongly right after a reward that followed a non-rewarded trial (mid-episode, trials ~10-59)
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2), only when the D1 reward input was 1, and only when the policy strongly prefers a2 (choice logit < -4.4; model_act = a2 on all activations, 99.98% of activations have action a2). Rate is higher when the trial before the reward was unrewarded (or outside the window), i.e. a reward following a non-reward. It is also strongly confined to episode trials ~10-59 (zero activations after trial 60, few before 10), and to a narrow band of the value head (7.73-8.10), suggesting it tracks a slowly drifting hidden-state regime rather than a trial event. Base condition GO & prev_reward==1 & choice<-4.44 has recall 1.0 but precision 0.09; adding the previous-unrewarded, value-band and episode-window conditions gives dev F1 0.60 (P 0.46, R 0.88). Uses no future variables (choice and value are the model own outputs at that step). Does not fire after a1 choices, after unrewarded trials, or late in episodes. Magnitude modulation not characterized beyond these conditions.
